points.point: Why Blotato removes the music from a TikTok video
TikTok video (not a slideshow) loses audio after posting

verdict.reason: No entry explains why a TikTok video (not a slideshow) loses its audio when Blotato posts it; the TikTok music sentences only cover autoAddMusic for API photo/slideshow posts, and the other entries cover Instagram, Google Business Profile, auth, or upload errors, so this should go to a person on the team.
